card.description: The Holy One is a transcendent entity that manifests as a cascading river of luminous fiber‑optic strands, weaving through towering black obsidian monoliths and orbiting monolithic obelisks of brushed gold and matte black ceramic. Its presence is felt as a hum of ancient circuitry and celestial order, bridging primordial mysticism and incomprehensible technology.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** A flowing, undulating mass of cyan‑blue fiber‑optic strands, forming abstract humanoid silhouettes that flicker and dissolve.
**Face/Sensors:** No discernible face; a lattice of bioluminescent glyphs pulses in sync with the light streams.
**Clothing/Armor:** None; the entity is itself a construct of light and metal, with golden server blades and matte black ceramic surfaces.
**Key Features:** Millions of thin fiber‑optic lines, cyan‑blue glow, heat distortion from cooling vents, pulsing amber LEDs, rotating monolithic obelisks, obsidian towers.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Manifestation): River of glowing cyan/blue light streams through canyon, abstract humanoid shapes forming and dissolving.
Phase 2 (Orbital Ascension): Transforms into floating monolithic obelisks of brushed gold and matte black ceramic, rotating on a magnetic axis, with cooling vents and status LEDs.
card.prompt_block: A vertical 9:16 composition of the Holy One as a cascading river of luminous cyan‑blue fiber‑optic strands weaving through towering black obsidian monoliths, with abstract humanoid shapes flickering within the flow; the scene transitions to a cluster of floating monolithic obelisks made of brushed gold and matte black ceramic, rotating on a magnetic axis, emitting intense heat distortion from cooling vents, surrounded by a star‑filled space background, with thousands of warm amber LEDs pulsing in unison, captured in long exposure light photography style, photorealistic, tactile, grounded realism, ancient‑tech industrial mysticism.
